summary: Frontend-only verification of the Vision 2030 Ultra-Luxury Tourism Scorecard sync (6-step protocol) on the preview build. 11 of 13 verification points PASS. 2 FAIL due to client-side JS overwriting the static HTML that carried the required data-testids, and the backing APIs not yet including the new Scorecard row. Static article, JSON-LD, sitemap, RSS, hero teaser card, featured news card, publications hub, language toggle, and cover image are all correct. The two failing surfaces (hero brief list + Cited & Syndicated strip) both have correct SEO fallback HTML but the runtime JS replaces them with API data that is out of sync.

minor.issue: Response omits the Hotel News Resource article142297 (Vision 2030 Scorecard) entry. The static HTML has HNR at position #1 with data-testid=press-hnr-scorecard-link, but as soon as /api/press/citations returns, the JS in index.html (line 1305-1339) does ul.innerHTML = ... which wipes the HNR row. The API returns 24 citations starting with 'Peak Hospitality · Peak Newswire' — HNR/scorecard is not present at all. Also citations count is 24 (rendered from data-ib-stat) rather than the '12 verified citations' referenced in the review request. If the intent is to show 12, this needs backend seed update.

Returns the scorecard headline correctly at position #0, BUT its 'loc' points to the sister-site URL (https://intelligence.insightbridge.global/articles/vision-2030-ultra-luxury-tourism-scorecard-may-predictions-july-confirmed) instead of the new main-site article (/publications/vision-2030-scorecard.html). Additionally, the client JS (index.html line 5652-5669) unconditionally prepends a hard-coded 'The Biggest Mistake Hotels…' HospitalityNet item BEFORE the API results, so on the rendered page the Jul 29 Scorecard is NOT the top brief entry (Jun 9 HospitalityNet is).

ui_bugs.component: Hero brief list (right column, THE BRIEF / Latest Headlines)
ui_bugs.issue: The static HTML at /app/frontend/site/index.html line ~1027 has the Scorecard as the top entry with data-testid="brief-scorecard" and href=/publications/vision-2030-scorecard.html. However the IIFE at line 5600 calls fetch('/api/headlines?limit=7') then does list.innerHTML = '' and re-renders items WITHOUT the data-testid. The rendered top item is 'The Biggest Mistake Hotels Are Making About AI' (Jun 9, 2026, hard-coded feature) and the Scorecard sits at position #2 and points to sister-site URL — not the main-site article. Result: data-testid="brief-scorecard" is absent from rendered DOM and the review requirement 'new top entry dated Jul 29, 2026 that links to the new scorecard page' fails.

Static HTML at line ~1259 has HNR/scorecard at top with data-testid="press-hnr-scorecard-link". The IIFE at line 1305 calls /api/press/citations and does ul.innerHTML = ... which erases the testid. Rendered top row is 'Peak Hospitality · Peak Newswire' (no HNR/scorecard row present). Also citations counter reads 24, not the 12 referenced by the review request.

integration_issues.issue: Two hydration functions (hero brief + press citations) do a destructive innerHTML rewrite that strips required data-testids and (for the brief list) hard-codes an older featured item ahead of the API data. Also the sister-site URL is used for the scorecard loc, not the new main-site article. Both need to (a) preserve/re-emit data-testids and (b) point the Scorecard entry to /publications/vision-2030-scorecard.html.

action_items: Update /api/headlines to emit /publications/vision-2030-scorecard.html as the loc for the Scorecard row (main-site article, not sister-site).

In index.html hero-brief render() (line 5600–5669), stop hard-coding the 'Biggest Mistake Hotels' item at the top OR move it after the API results, so the Jul 29 Scorecard is #1. Also add data-testid="brief-scorecard" to the anchor when the item's loc matches /publications/vision-2030-scorecard.html.

Update /api/press/citations to include Hotel News Resource · article142297 (Vision 2030 Scorecard) at position #0. Fix count to 12 if that is the intended number (review request says '12 verified citations'; API currently returns 24).

In the press-citations JS re-render (line 1316–1336), when the row url matches https://www.hotelnewsresource.com/article142297.html, emit the anchor with data-testid="press-hnr-scorecard-link" so the testid is preserved after hydration.
Consider a general pattern: if API returns empty or errors, keep static fallback intact; if API returns data, merge testids by-URL rather than blowing away innerHTML.
critical_code_review_comments: index.html is 5678 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Extract hero-brief hydration, press-citations hydration, and language toggle to separate JS modules in /assets/js/.
Destructive innerHTML re-render (line 1317 and 5621) discards SEO-critical data-testid attributes. Prefer DOM diffing or preserve attributes via a merge step keyed on href/url.
Manual hard-coded 'featured' array inside the hero-brief render (line 5656) creates a hidden ordering coupling that overrides what the API returns; move to backend/CMS-driven.
The /api/press/citations count (24) is inconsistent with the review-requested '12 verified citations' claim — either the copy or the data is wrong; verify authoritative source.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Article page at /publications/vision-2030-scorecard.html is 100% correct: cover image loads (1376x768 nat width), EN/CN language toggle works via [data-testid=lang-btn-en|cn], attrib-box + backlinks-panel present with 3-layer links (HNR + sister + author + original May), JSON-LD @graph[0] NewsArticle contains isBasedOn=HNR, sameAs=[HNR,sister], citation=[HNR,sister,original May 13]. Sitemap and RSS include the new URL with cover image. Homepage: vision2030-hero-teaser (JUST PUBLISHED card) is correct, scorecard-featured-card with scorecard-read-btn and scorecard-hnr-btn is correct, top-level JSON-LD NewsArticle for scorecard is correct. Publications hub has pub-scorecard-item at index 0, Opinion filter still works (15 items). REMAINING BUGS are exclusively at the hero brief list and cited-worldwide strip (both blown away by JS calling backend APIs that return outdated data and a JS re-render that drops data-testids). Fix requires BOTH backend (/api/headlines loc & /api/press/citations list) AND frontend (preserve testids in re-render, remove hard-coded feature prepend).
rca of the issue: Two hydration IIFEs in /app/frontend/site/index.html perform destructive innerHTML rewrites over the SEO fallback HTML. (1) Lines 1305-1339 fetch /api/press/citations and overwrite the ib-cited-logos <ul> — the API response does not include HNR/article142297, so the scorecard row and its data-testid=press-hnr-scorecard-link disappear from the rendered DOM. (2) Lines 5600-5669 fetch /api/headlines and rebuild #hero-brief-list from scratch, without re-emitting data-testid=brief-scorecard, and additionally prepend a hard-coded Jun 9 HospitalityNet item so the Jul 29 Scorecard is not the top brief. The API returns the Scorecard headline pointing at intelligence.insightbridge.global rather than /publications/vision-2030-scorecard.html. Reproduction: curl the two endpoints — /api/press/citations returns 24 items starting with 'Peak Hospitality', no HNR row; /api/headlines returns Scorecard at index 0 but with sister-site loc. Mitigation: (a) update backend seed data for both endpoints to include the correct HNR row and correct loc; (b) modify JS to preserve data-testid when the row corresponds to the scorecard; (c) remove the hard-coded Jun-9 prepend from the hero-brief render or place it after the API items.
